flow_vs_diff: Same tiny U-Net, data, recipe and 4,000 training steps, scored on 1,000 samples (FD in the classifier's feature space; 1,000 real images score 18.9): flow matching with Euler reaches FD 158.3 at 4 steps and 64.4 at 10, where the DDPM model with DDIM scores 478.9 and 181.3; with the midpoint solver flow reaches 47.3 at 4 network evaluations, while DDPM's stochastic sampler needs 250 steps for 39.7 measured on Apple M1 Pro (MPS). One network evaluation costs the same for both models, so evaluations are sampling time. On the 2-D toy, one Euler step puts 0% of the points on a mode before reflow and 90% after; on the images, reflow takes 1-step FD from 1,253.5 to 159.8 measured.
t_flow: about 25 minutes (25.3 at 200 words per minute, measured by check_page.mjs on 2026-10-17), plus about 7 for the folded interview answers and code
